hero.description: Engineering distributed systems, end-to-end typed <1>Web</1> and <3>Mobile</3> applications, and low-latency RESTful <5>APIs</5> in Node.js and Go.

about.title: Engineering & Core Stack
about.p1: Full Stack Developer holding a B.Sc. in Information Systems, focused on building deterministic software, normalized relational data models, and high-density operational interfaces.
about.p2: Operating across the full <1>Full Stack</1> lifecycle, I architect reactive clients with offline-first persistence alongside concurrent backend services in Go and Node.js under strict data contracts.
about.p3: I prioritize maintainable code, isolated domain logic, containerized Docker workflows, and automated testing.

highlights.frontend: Reactive, keyboard-accessible interfaces built with React 19, React Native, and strict TypeScript typing.
highlights.backend: Low-latency RESTful APIs and concurrent microservices engineered with Go (Gin) and Node.js.
highlights.database: Normalized relational schemas, indexing strategies, and ACID transactions in PostgreSQL, MySQL, and SQLite.

projects.subtitle: Technical specifications, solved engineering problems, and architectural decisions for each system.

aether.short: Modular enterprise ERP unifying POS, transactional inventory control, financial ledger, and BI.
aether.problem: Data fragmentation across point-of-sale (POS) operations, stock deduction, and financial reconciliation in retail workflows.
aether.architecture: Modular monolith in Node.js + transactional PostgreSQL (ACID) with a React + TypeScript SPA client and analytical reporting.
aether.full: End-to-end ERP system engineered to eliminate inconsistencies between POS checkout, physical inventory, accounts payable/receivable, and CRM, ensuring transactional integrity in PostgreSQL.

tcc.short: Native mobile client featuring offline-first operation and transactional record synchronization.
tcc.problem: Data loss and blocked operational workflows on mobile devices operating under unstable or absent network connectivity.
tcc.architecture: React Native (Expo) + embedded SQLite local persistence + asynchronous REST synchronization queue.
tcc.full: Mobile application built to guarantee continuous field availability via local SQLite storage, deterministic TypeScript state management, and automatic data reconciliation upon network recovery.

tcc_api.short: RESTful backend service in Go for concurrent request processing and relational persistence.
tcc_api.problem: Serialization bottlenecks, authentication overhead, and concurrency contention during simultaneous mobile client syncs.
tcc_api.architecture: Go REST API + Gin framework + layered architecture (Handler/Service/Repository) + MySQL connection pooling.
tcc_api.full: High-throughput backend service written in Go (Golang) utilizing Gin routing, authentication middlewares, strict payload validation, and parameterized MySQL queries.

goshortner.short: Low-latency HTTP URL shortening and redirection microservice written in Go.
goshortner.problem: Lookup latency on short URL hashes and the need for lightweight, reproducible container deployments.
goshortner.architecture: Go HTTP service + collision-resistant slug generation + low-allocation 301/302 redirects + multi-stage Docker container.
goshortner.full: Lean microservice in Go engineered for fast HTTP redirection, click telemetry, and minimal image footprint via multi-stage Docker builds.

netpulse.short: Real-time network availability and latency telemetry monitoring system.
netpulse.problem: Lack of real-time visibility into route degradation, packet loss, and downtime across critical infrastructure endpoints.
netpulse.architecture: Asynchronous Node.js collector + periodic health-check engine + reactive dashboard in React + TypeScript.
netpulse.full: Observability system performing active probes against services and hosts, aggregating response-time series and operational status into a technical dashboard.

dile.short: Full Stack platform with end-to-end typed contracts between React client and Node.js server.
dile.problem: Schema drift and contract mismatches between web client and backend API during rapid domain iteration.
dile.architecture: React SPA client + Node.js REST API written in TypeScript with schema validation and decoupled service layers.
dile.full: Full Stack architecture integrating reactive frontend and RESTful backend in TypeScript, enforcing strict input validation, standardized HTTP error handling, and reliable persistence.

vendas.short: Operational web interface for order management, product catalog, and commercial KPIs.
vendas.problem: Slow manual order entry and lack of immediate revenue metric aggregation in daily sales operations.
vendas.architecture: React + TypeScript SPA + optimized local state engine + high-density responsive UI in Tailwind CSS.
vendas.full: Web system optimized for rapid order input and commercial operations, featuring instant in-memory filtering, automated total computation, and sales performance analytics.

juros.short: Compound interest, amortization, and financial time-series simulation engine.
juros.problem: Floating-point rounding inaccuracies and lack of granular period-by-period breakdown in financial projections.
juros.architecture: Deterministic financial calculation engine in TypeScript + instant tabular evolution rendering in React.
juros.full: Technical tool for exact computation of equivalent rates, recurring contributions, and period-by-period equity progression with instant tabular output.

portfolio.short: Multilingual technical web application with command palette (Cmd+K) and zero bloated UI dependencies.
portfolio.problem: Bloated portfolio templates with poor information density, slow asset loading, and weak keyboard accessibility.
portfolio.architecture: React 19 + Vite SWC + Tailwind CSS v4 + i18next (4 locales) + keyboard-driven Command Palette + Vitest suite.
portfolio.full: Web platform engineered under lean technical standards: fast asset delivery, full keyboard navigation (⌘K), four-language internationalization, and automated unit testing.
